description: I spent some time reviewing the recent commission hearing regarding the proposed 40-unit complex at Spring and 8th. While we all agree that Lewistown needs more housing, we have to ask: At what cost to our existing neighborhoods? It was telling that over 40 local residents showed up in opposition, raising valid concerns about historic character and narrow-street congestion, yet the project was moved forward with three major variances.
